history.summary: A 2BR (872 sqft) in Kingsford's 916-unit Chuan Park new launch (TOP 2028), 210m from Lorong Chuan MRT in the mature Serangoon/Bishan corridor. At $2,439 PSF it is priced ~9% below the $2,679 URA project median, with very deep liquidity (916 units, 870 txns) and direct MRT adjacency.
history.rating_rationale: The 2BR ticks the strongest boxes: $2.13M quantum near the deep-pool band, 210m walk to Lorong Chuan (Circle Line), 916 units with 870 transactions = strong exit liquidity, and a $2,439 PSF that undercuts the project median of $2,679 by ~9%. Mid-launch range per market reviews ($2,200-2,700 psf), and the first comparable new launch in the Lorong Chuan area in over a decade gives pent-up upgrader demand. Kingsford build quality is the watch-item (mixed past reputation), and new-launch pricing carries forward-pricing risk, but the value-vs-median and location case is solid for a 2BR.
red_flags: Kingsford Development has a mixed build-quality/QC track record historically
New-launch pricing carries developer forward-pricing premium (has_new_launch_bias true)
TOP only 2028 — capital tied up with no rental income until completion
catalysts: 210m to Lorong Chuan MRT (Circle Line) — direct transit adjacency
First major new launch in Lorong Chuan in 10+ years — pent-up upgrader demand
Strong school catchment + mature Serangoon/Bishan corridor
Priced ~9% below project URA median PSF

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: 2BR is the widest tenant pool; MRT-adjacency and Bishan/Serangoon proximity support steady demand once TOP'd, yield ~3-3.5%.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: No clean resale CAGR (new launch), so leaning on location and below-median entry; CCR/RCR-adjacent leasehold with MRT at door typically holds value, but 916-unit supply absorption at TOP is the risk.

history.summary: Quality Kingsford new launch (Circle Line 210m, 916 units, completing 2028) but priced at a full OCR new-launch premium with no genuine value edge; the prior '9% below median' was a size-PSF artifact, not a discount.
history.rating_rationale: Recent 2BR prints (732-743sf, Jan-2026) transacted $2,668-2,685psf; this 872sf 2BR at $2,439psf is lower PSF only because it is larger (size-relative PSF), not cheap. $2,439-2,650psf is premium for D19/OCR (resale norm ~$1,800-2,200). New-launch pricing already capitalises future upside; engine de-credits it. Good location/liquidity keep it off Avoid.
red_flags: full new-launch premium pricing in OCR
'discount vs median' is a size effect
history.as_of: 2026-06 re-judgment under v3.10b priors (de-biased value+region lead, trailing CAGR≈0, deep-discount/yield trust rules)
